title: Trezor Safe 7 Review: The FOSS Self Custody Hardware Wallet
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Trezor Safe 7 Review: The FOSS Self Custody Hardware Wallet Trezor’s $249 Safe 7 pairs a 20-word SLIP-39 Shamir backup with TROPIC01, Optiga, and STM32 entropy — and Bluetooth that the review treats as warm storage, not cold. This post Trezor Safe 7 Review: The FOSS Self Custody Hardware Wallet first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt .
